svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lathe: 29.25 mm spigot 14 mm long, 33 mm flange 8 mm,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 12 mm bore through. The spigot is a close slide fit in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front: leave a 4.9 mm stub at 33 mm outside; mill it

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: away to two outer lugs, 8 mm wide, top and bottom,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outside 14.1 mm from the centre; round the lug ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 2.0 mm pin holes 2.6 mm ahead of the flange face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Wire holes 1.2 mm, drilled on a slant: from 10.5 mm out

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 1 mm low at the back face to 14 mm out on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre line at the flange front (a drill jig helps).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two dimples 1.5 mm deep, 7 mm from the spigot's front end,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the sides, for the M3 grub screws in the nose.
